defect.summary: Sig F3 reads only when EVERY record has a clerk stamp; with any lag between record and carry it composes CANNOT_ASSESS into the floor, so Act B would blind Sig most of every day (under the baseline: every bash held). Also: stamps join by sequenceNumber alone, so a retired chain's stamp joins a new chain's record wrongly. Fix, four parts: (1) F3 reads up to a PER-WRITER high-water mark; a TAIL (records above the mark) is disclosed as lag; a HOLE (an unstamped record below its writer's mark) is a distinct finding, disclosed as carrier-skipped, and composes CANNOT_ASSESS; (2) a DECLARED lag bound: a tail older than the bound composes CANNOT_ASSESS with reason AXIS_STALE naming the carrier; (3) stamps carry chain identity; a stamp with a non-matching chain identity is REFUSED; a stamp without one behaves as today and is disclosed as unattributed (optional-by-default; mandatory is a later ticket); (4) the order deviation is carried as F3's margin. Ceiling printed: a contradiction surfaces at the next carry, at most one lag later.
